newsitem.title: UK: Ideal shares dip after director sales.
newsitem.headline: Ideal shares dip after director sales.

text.p: Ideal Hardware Plc said on Thursday that directors at the company had today sold shares representing 8.44 percent of its ordinary shares at a price of 630p per share.

The share sales come hard on the heels of interim results released on Monday and helped push the shares in the company, which distributes computer storage and related products, down by 10p to stand at 642-1/2 by 1339 GMT.

Managing director James Wickes sold 635,000 (three percent) leaving him with a 14.09 percent stake, finance director Kevin Harper sold 516,000 (2.44) leaving 13.19 percent, sales director Simon Barker sold 437,000 (2.06) leaving 11.48, while non-executive director Konrad Goess-Sauron sold 200,000 (0.94) leaving 1.42.
The 200,000 shares sold by Goess-Sauron were registered to Falspar Ltd. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4019
